notes.title: Tap and Play: Barbie in Action - Free Update Now Live!🍑💥
notes.notes:
Hey there, fabulous players! 💖

Get ready to step into a whole new world of fun, sass, and just the right amount of tap-tastic action, because our latest free update, "Barbie in Action: Tap and Play," is here to spank up your gameplay! (pun intended, of course)

We’ve always known that our game wasn’t just about living that fabulous plastic life—it’s about exploring the endless possibilities of play. And what better way to do that than by adding a playful spanking feature that’s guaranteed to bring out the cheeky side of everyone?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283213/f1697bd50163869a666e82fd23499c4c63b428c8.gif

💥 What’s New?
    
 Playful Spanking Mode: Lighthearted, cheeky fun at your fingertips (or controllers) AVAILABLE FOR PC AND VR MODE.
 Available Everywhere: Every scene, every character.
 New dedicated VO: Feel the tap, live the drama.

💋 Stay fabulous, keep tapping, and don’t forget to share your thoughts with us, we're always looking for ways to improve our toys!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283213/f948a935ad5eac46143de7ec606ea8c9daa5998c.jpg

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and improved VR camera
notes.notes:
We've added Audio / Voiceover controls in Settings.
VR Camera now uses head tilt so you can view the sex positions in a more natural way.

Bug fix related to eye blinks
notes.notes: We've fixed a bug that was causing the eyes to stay shut for a long period of time instead of a quick blink.
